enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Acidic 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 2d6 Acid damage on each hit.
Critical Weakening 1: This deadly weapon saps the power and might from your enemies, dealing 1 Strength damage on each critical hit.
Deception +2: +2 Enhancement bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
